summary: A motion graphics prompt designed to generate a dynamic 15-second looped showreel video highlighting a product's strengths.

post.originalText:
I asked Opus 5.5 why it's so good at motion design. Its answer:

"'Best' isn't mine to claim. But I don't keyframe, I write the math. Every frame is a function of time, so loops are perfect and sound lands on the exact frame.

What I don't have is your taste."
Master prompt 🧵 https://t.co/h5tzF6ackG
